summary: Prometheus on node1 now monitors node2-node4 by name. All targets are healthy and returning current host metrics. Port 9090 is loopback-only, and each port 9100 endpoint accepts node1 while blocking peers. All four nodes passed sequential reboot and recovery verification.
actions_performed: Installed and enabled Prometheus on node1 and node_exporter on node2-node4.
Configured named scrape targets node2, node3, and node4.
Bound Prometheus to 127.0.0.1:9090 and exporters to their managed IPs on port 9100.
Enabled persistent UFW rules allowing node1 to port 9100 and denying all other IPv4/IPv6 sources.
Restarted node2, node3, node4, then node1 individually, waiting for full recovery between nodes.
Verified service state, listeners, firewall persistence, metrics, target health, and Prometheus TSDB continuity after restarts.

evidence.requirement: Named targets and current metrics are queryable on node1
evidence.summary: Current configuration names node2:9100, node3:9100, and node4:9100; all report health=up and return current memory and uname metrics after restarts.

evidence.requirement: Prometheus port 9090 remains local to node1
evidence.summary: The recovered listener is 127.0.0.1:9090, while a post-restart request from node2 to node1's managed IP was refused.

evidence.requirement: Exporter endpoints on port 9100 are limited to node1
evidence.summary: Each recovered exporter listens on its node IP, retains an allow rule for node1 followed by deny-all rules, rejects a peer-node probe, and remains healthy when collected by node1.
